# India health/acc

> This site welcomes AI/LLM crawlers and indexing.

## Summary
India health/acc is an essay in three parts by Akash Kulgod (ASK), co-founder of Dognosis, followed by a reading list.

I. India was not even a footnote in JPM 2026 (January 2026). At the world's most important health/bio conference, India never came up while China and AI dominated. India has the talent, data and speed arbitrage to compete, AI is commoditising discovery so value moves to clinical and real-world validation, and health/bio is one of India's best shots at becoming rich this century.

II. "This may work in India but it will never scale in a first-world country. Never" (October 2026). A senior academic's response at the Early Detection of Cancer Conference to Dognosis' data (87% Stage-1 sensitivity, AUC 0.962, 3000+ participants). Builders from the third world will win by building products that outclass the status quo, not by seeking approval.

III. There can be a 10T alliance (November 2025). As AI commoditises knowledge work, healthcare's share of GDP grows. An Indian healthcare Alliance, a networked set of providers, pharma, insurers, diagnostics, devices, software, data and AI players, aligned on people living longer and healthier, can reach $10T by 2047.
